descriptionParagraphs: SuperN supplies plant-available nitrogen from approved organic sources to support strong growth and yield where synthetic nitrogen is not desired or permitted.
Use rates depend on crop, rotation, and soil test results. Our team can help align application with your fertility plan and certification requirements.
